title: B2C Marketing Executive - 12 month FTC
description:
Think Specialist Recruitment are delighted to be working with a Global organisation based within the Watford area. This company are a market leader within their field, they have an exciting opportunity for a Degree educated candidate with 1-2 years experience, to join their Brand Marketing team. This position will be working closely with the Brand Marketing Managers, playing a key part in planning, delivering and executing brand plans for the business.
This person will need to have 1-2 years experience within Marketing, and due to the fact this company work within the office 4 days, this person will need to be local to the office.

Salary - 28,000 - 32,000 depending on experience
Monday - Friday 9am - 5pm - 4 days in and 1 day from home
Please note - this is an initial 12 month FTC
Some of the duties will include:
- Supporting annual brand plans and coordinating activity across multiple channels
- Helping lead SEO, eCRM and social activity, working with both internal teams and external agencies
- Developing and refining messaging across social, PR, SEO and campaign assets
- Supporting new product launches and working with Product, Trade and Digital teams on go-to-market plans
- Ensuring product and website content is accurate, engaging, optimised and focused on consumer benefits
- Briefing agencies, reviewing creative, coordinating feedback and keeping projects moving
- Ensuring communications consistently reflect brand positioning, tone of voice and visual identity
- Coordinating activity with internal and external partners to deliver a smooth customer experience
- Conducting brand, competitor, marketing and retail audits to identify trends, gaps and opportunities
- Supporting budgets, purchase orders, reporting and day-to-day project management

The suitable candidate:
- 1-2 years experience within a marketing focused role
- Previous experience delivering marketing campaigns across multiple channels
- Strong communication skills on all levels both verbal and written
- Has the ability to multi-task and prioritise a busy workload
- Can build strong working relationships both internally and externally
- A good understanding of social media
- Must be local to Watford

Looking for the next step in your career? Think Specialist Recruitment.

Think Specialist Recruitment is an independent support staff recruitment agency based in Hemel Hempstead and working across the Herts, Beds and Bucks area. We specialise in permanent, temporary and contract recruitment with areas of expertise including: administration, customer service/call centre, PA/secretarial, human resources, accountancy and finance, sales admin/sales support, marketing and IT Helpdesk/IT support

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Digital Marketing Executive

We re looking for an experienced, creative and hands-on Digital Marketing Executive to join our growing team and help develop our digital presence.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing online company that provides a range of online recruitment advertising solutions to a diverse client base, including British Airways, Nando s, Heathrow Airport, NatWest and many more.

We re a small team, which means you ll work closely with decision-makers and have a genuine opportunity to shape our marketing activity and make a visible impact.

This isn t a role where you ll be restricted to a narrow job description. We re looking for someone who enjoys variety, takes initiative and is happy getting involved across different areas of the business.

You ll be comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where you ll have the freedom to be creative, experiment with new approaches and see the results of your work.

You ll also be working on an award-winning website dedicated to empowering women in technology and helping to close the gender gap across the industry. So if you re passionate about diversity, inclusion and equality, it s a great opportunity to put your marketing skills towards something with a genuine purpose and make a positive difference.

The role is fully remote, with occasional travel to Hertfordshire/London for team meetings or events.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and grow our social media presence across all relevant channels.
- Plan, create and publish engaging, insightful and relevant content, including articles, guides and thought-leadership pieces.
- Develop and manage the content calendar.
- Coordinate and distribute email newsletters and marketing campaigns.
- Support the development and delivery of SEO strategies to improve organic visibility and website performance.
- Assist with the management and optimisation of Google Ads and paid social campaigns.
- Monitor website performance using Google Analytics, providing regular analysis and performance reports.
- Work closely with the sales team to coordinate client campaigns, monitor performance and help achieve agreed objectives.
- Support the planning, promotion and delivery of events.
- Identify opportunities to improve our digital marketing activity and proactively suggest new ideas.
- Test, measure and refine campaigns to understand what works and drive continuous improvement.
- Keep up to date with digital marketing trends, tools and emerging opportunities.

Skills & Experience

We re looking for someone with a good understanding of digital marketing who is creative, organised and enjoys taking ideas from planning through to delivery.

You ll ideally have:
- Good practical knowledge of SEO and social media marketing.
- Experience with tools such as Google Analytics, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, HubSpot, Canva and WordPress/Elementor.
- Good analytical skills and the ability to interpret data, identify trends and use insights to improve performance.
- Excellent content creation and copywriting skills.
- A creative approach to campaigns, content and problem-solving.
- Good project management, organisational and time-management skills.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Exceptional attention to detail.
- A proactive, positive and "let s give it a go" attitude.
- The ability to come up with thoughtful, original ideas and turn them into action.
- The confidence to work independently, take ownership and make things happen.

Most importantly

We re looking for someone who enjoys working in a small, growing business.

Someone who doesn t need everything mapped out for them. Someone who will spot an opportunity, suggest an idea and make it happen.

You might be planning an SEO strategy in the morning, writing an article after lunch and reviewing campaign performance in the afternoon.

If you re creative, curious, commercially minded and hands-on, and you re excited by the opportunity to make a real difference, we d love to hear from you.

title: External Engagement Officer
description:
External Engagement Officer
Salary - 32,000 depending on experience plus other Veolia benefits

Location - Wiggenhall Road, Watford, WD18 0 FB, and 210 Pentonville Road, London, N1 9 JY

Hours - 40 hours per week. Monday to Friday. 9am to 5.30pm
Your application must include a CV and a covering letter evidencing how you meet the job criteria. Applications without a CV and a covering letter will not be considered.
When you see the world as we do, you see the chance to help the world take better care of its resources, and help it become a better place for everyone. It's why we're looking for someone who's just as committed as we are, to push for genuine change and bring our ambition of Ecological Transformation to life.
We know that everyone here at Veolia can help us work alongside our communities, look after the environment, and contribute to our inclusive culture.
What we can offer you;
- 25 days of annual leave
- Access to our company pension scheme
- Discounts on everything from groceries to well known retailers
- Access to a range of resources to support your physical, mental and financial health; so you can lean on us whenever you need to
- One paid days leave every year to volunteer and support your community
- Ongoing training and development opportunities, allowing you to reach your full potential
- Stream - Employee financial wellbeing support: early access to your earned pay, savings, budgeting, financial coaching & reward

What you'll be doing
An exciting opportunity has arisen for an External Engagement Officer to design and deliver strategic campaigns to support local authorities to promote recycling and waste minimisation.
As an External Engagement Officer, you will develop engaging digital social media content for local authorities in a number of formats, including video, and will have the chance to make a real impact on recycling rates by communicating with residents using innovative digital techniques. You will also lead on reactive and proactive press for your area, with the opportunity to identify and develop good news stories throughout the year.
You will support your team by communicating with residents to solve issues, including delivering face-to-face community engagement activities to achieve project goals, and responding to resident complaints on social media. This could include identifying target groups and developing appropriate strategies to deliver key messages, delivering community events, and door-knocking target areas.
You will have the experience of working in a team to deliver projects and will be confident in managing a varied workload.
You will need to be a detail oriented and creative individual who is confident in communicating concisely and clearly.
This role will involve working in both Watford and Kings Cross in a hybrid manner. Some evening and weekend work will be required on occasion and a full driving licence and experience of driving in the UK is preferable.
The experience you will need
Essential:
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
- Understand how to utilise social media campaigns and tailor communication to different audiences
- Confident in developing content in multiple formats, and will possess filming and basic video editing skills
- Have excellent attention to detail, planning and organisational skills and a proven ability to prioritise workloads and multi-task
- Experience of complaint resolution and speaking to the public

Desirable:
- Knowledge of the recycling sector
- Experience working with local authorities
- Experience designing and delivering social media, social advertising and digital campaigns
- Experience dealing with media proactively and reactively
- Full UK Driving Licence and experience of driving in the UK

You will be able to work unsupervised when necessary but will also be happy collaborating with teammates. You will be available to work weekends and evenings occasionally as and when it is required.

What's next?

Apply today, so we can make a difference for generations to come.

We're proud to have been named as one of The Sunday Times Best Places to Work for three consecutive years in 2023, 2024 and 2025. This consistent recognition reflects our commitment to our people, demonstrating that Veolia is not just transforming the environment, we're also transforming what it means to have a rewarding, purposeful career.

We're dedicated to supporting you throughout your application journey, offering adjustments where reasonable and appropriate. As a proud Disability Confident Employer, we will offer an interview to applicants with a disability or long-term condition who opt-in to the Disability Confident scheme, and meet the minimum criteria for our roles.

We're also committed to ensuring that all applicants and colleagues receive fair treatment without discrimination on any grounds, aiming to create a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

title: Marketing Coordinator
description:
Social Media & Marketing Coordinator (Entry Level)
Location: Welwyn Garden City, Hertfordshire
Salary: Up to £30,000 + Benefits

Grown your own social media following? Know your way around software like Canva, CapCut and AI tools? Want to turn that into a proper marketing career? This entry-level Social Media & Marketing Coordinator role is a great place to start.

About the company
A respected private housebuilder delivering high-quality new homes across Hertfordshire and the surrounding area, based at their head office in Welwyn Garden City. It's a close, friendly team where you'll work directly with the people running the business.

The role
This is a brand new role. The business is bringing its social media and marketing in-house for the first time, and wants someone keen and creative to take it on and grow with it. As Social Media & Marketing Coordinator you'll report to the Sales & Marketing Director, who will support you as you learn the property side.
You don't need years of marketing experience. You do need to know what makes people stop scrolling, and to be keen to learn the rest.

Key responsibilities:
- Creating and posting content across Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn
- Getting out to developments and show homes to take photos and short videos
- Designing graphics and writing captions, using tools like Canva, CapCut and AI where they help
- Updating the website with new developments and news
- Helping produce email newsletters, brochures and sales materials
- Supporting show home launches and sales events
- Planning a regular content calendar and keeping track of what gets the most engagement and enquiries

What they're looking for:
- Someone who's built and run their own social media, for themselves, a side project, a club or a small business, and can show it
- Confident on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and LinkedIn, and up to date with what works on each
- Quick to pick up new software. Experience with Canva, CapCut, Adobe or similar is a bonus
- Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to speed up ideas, captions and planning, while keeping it sounding human
- Creative, organised and happy to get out and about with a phone or camera
- Interest in property or housebuilding is a plus, but not essential, and a marketing or media qualification is nice to have
- A full UK driving licence, as you'll be out on site regularly

What's on offer:
- Salary up to £30,000 depending on experience
- 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays
- Private healthcare with BUPA after probation
- A brand new role you can make your own, with real responsibility from day one
- Support from the Sales & Marketing Director, and a clear chance to build a career in marketing
- Monday to Friday, 8.30am-5pm, office based in Welwyn Garden City, with regular site visits

If you're a creative, social-savvy person who wants to turn what you already do online into a Social Media & Marketing Coordinator career, this is a great first step.

To apply, send your CV along with links to the social accounts or content you're proudest of.

title: Marketing Executive - Professional Services
description:
As a Marketing Executive - Professional Services, you will manage day-to-day marketing activity for a growing firm, helping to keep campaigns and communications organised. You will work closely with the wider team to deliver clear, consistent marketing that supports the wider business.

Client Details

The organisation operates in the Professional Services industry and has offices in between Watford and St. Albans.

Please note - this is an office based role

Description

As the Marketing Executive - Professional Services, you will have the following responsibilities:
- Support the delivery of multi-channel marketing campaigns across digital, content, email, social media and events.
- Coordinate and attend industry events, exhibitions and networking opportunities, helping to generate leads and raise brand awareness.
- Identify and engage prospective clients through targeted business development and marketing activity.
- Create and manage marketing content including email campaigns, social media posts, website updates and promotional materials.
- Track campaign performance, analyse results and provide insights to optimise future activity.
- Maintain CRM and marketing databases, ensuring accurate reporting of leads, opportunities and campaign effectiveness.
- Work closely with sales and commercial teams to support lead generation, pipeline growth and customer engagement.
- Monitor market trends, competitor activity and customer insights to identify new opportunities for growth.

Profile

A successful Marketing Executive - Professional Services should have:
- Experience delivering day-to-day marketing activity, ideally gained from within a professional services environment
- Experience coordinating marketing campaigns from planning through to delivery.
- Experience planning, coordinating and supporting events, exhibitions and networking activities, with a proven ability to maximise engagement and generate new business opportunities.
- Ability to create clear marketing content and communications.
- Confidence managing multiple marketing tasks and deadlines.
- Strong attention to detail when reviewing marketing materials and information.
- Ability to keep campaign plans, documents and actions well organised.

Job Offer
- Salary of 35,000 to 45,000 dependent on the level of experience.
- Please note that this role will be office based (office is based between Watford and St. Albans).

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

People are at the heart of Michael Page. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment. As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.
